e3.rule: gate-accepted and collective (full, all residual agents mobile) Delta U >= 3 J; 20 at ranks round(linspace(0, n_q - 1, 20)) of the qualifying list sorted by (Delta U, seed)

e4.rule: gate-accepted and n_resid >= 2 (blocker plus at least one neighbour); 10 at ranks round(linspace(0, n_q - 1, 10)) of the qualifying list sorted by (Delta U, seed)

pair.rule: the 46 pair snapshots sorted by mu1 (smallest Hessian eigenvalue, key lambda1); 12 at ranks round(linspace(0, 45, 12))

cost.source: mean wall_s per arm over the 26 E2 second-trap snapshots (data/E2/e2_quench.jsonl)
